summary.text: Candice Pierucci is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 49, where she has served since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit management.

paragraphs.text: Pierucci has been a member of the Utah House of Representatives since 2019.
Ballotpedia records that she served on the Government Operations Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions and was vice chair of the House Health and Human Services Committee in 2021-2022.
